baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus moves from seeing, through a repeated name for the approaching phenomenon and a confident rain claim, to an adversative correction naming wind and pain.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible but underdetermined arrival is classified by anticipated benefit. Public speech hardens that projection into a judgment, after which the correction separates visible form, physical carrier, and harmful payload.

activation_trace.role: Direct ocular perception supplies the initial datum but does not settle the datum's identity.
A phenomenon emerging at a distance supplies the ambiguous horizon form and functions as the object twice named.
Speech operating as judgment turns an uncertain sight into an asserted interpretation.
Descending water supplies the beneficial weather category projected onto the visible form.
Moving air supplies the actual physical carrier disclosed after the correction.
Inflicted suffering supplies the carrier's actual content and reverses the expected benefit.

changed_reading.before: A rain cloud is simply revealed to be a punishing wind.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages misclassification itself: desire names an ambiguous sight, speech fixes the guess, and correction splits appearance from carrier and payload.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The phenomenon faces the valleys, is expected to deliver rain to the group, but is a wind with suffering inside it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direction, channel, carrier, and contained payload form a delivery system. Terrain that normally routes beneficial flow is aligned with an incoming carrier whose internal content is destructive, so the same spatial fit supports opposite outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face orientation supplies the incoming vector and makes the valleys its receiving side.
A terrain passage that conducts runoff supplies the delivery network toward the settlements.
Rain supplies the expected beneficial material that makes the route look welcome.
Wind supplies the actual mobile medium moving along the aligned route.
Punitive pain replaces water as the material delivered by the carrier.
The pain-causing quality specifies the effect deposited at the route's human endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The approaching weather happens to move over their valleys.
changed_reading.after: The valley orientation is functional: a plausible water-delivery geometry is retained while its carrier and payload are inverted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rain expectation is interrupted by identifying the arrival as exactly what the addressees had sought ahead of time.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group seeks acceleration and reads the accelerated arrival through a category of requested good. The correction makes premature arrival recoil on the requesters: what looked like expedited provision is expedited exposure to pain.

activation_trace.role: Seeking something before its proper time supplies the temporal pressure driving the reversal.
Rain sought as a good supplies the desire-shaped category assigned to the arrival.
An uttered conviction makes the hoped-for category govern the group's reading.
Punishment supplies the actual event whose timing the request has brought into focus.

changed_reading.before: They wanted punishment quickly but happened to mistake it for rain.
changed_reading.after: Temporal impatience and beneficial expectation cooperate: the desired shortcut produces an arrival they can only recognize by misnaming it as expedited good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root first marks an agentive turning away from warning, then marks the visible phenomenon and its repeated label in the focus. The earlier refusal of orientation is recast as an object that now presents itself from the horizon and cannot be turned away from.

activation_trace.role: A warning meant to awaken caution supplies the message from which the earlier audience turns.
Presenting one's side while withdrawing supplies the prior human posture toward warning.
The later thing coming into view supplies a material counterpart to that earlier orientation.
Direct facing turns the once-avoidable warning into an unavoidable encounter.

structural_cues: The same root shifts from the audience's posture toward warning in 46:3 to the perceived object and its repeated predicate in 46:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root and the sequence from warning to encounter; I infer a reflexive return in which posture becomes presented object. A live alternative is lexical echo without causal or symbolic force.

changed_reading.before: The horizon form is merely ambiguous weather.
changed_reading.after: The horizon form can also be carried as the externalized return of an earlier act of averting: what they turned from now faces them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speakers repeatedly use confident declaration and a proximal label to recode arriving truth according to prior commitments, including a status test based on who arrived first. The focus weather claim becomes another instance of that interpretive habit rather than an isolated visual error.

activation_trace.role: Speech as adopted belief supplies an earlier confident classification of what has arrived.
Reality opposed to falsehood supplies the very object that the earlier classification fails to recognize.
Repeated doctrinal speech supplies a second case in which prior commitment governs the verdict.
Precedence and competition supply the social timing test used to decide whether something counts as good.
The focus utterance again converts inference into a verbal verdict before correction arrives.
Rain supplies the familiar beneficial category into which the new arrival is forced.

structural_cues: A proximal demonstrative follows speech in 46:7, 46:11, and 46:24, each time compressing an arriving object into a ready label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated declaration-label sequences and an explicit precedence test; I infer a stable recoding habit. The alternative is that the statements are locally independent and only rhetorically parallel.

changed_reading.before: Their weather judgment is a momentary mistake caused by distance.
changed_reading.after: Their weather judgment reenacts a durable method: declare first, fit the arrival to a prior value test, and let the label displace recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence of inward carrying, painful delivery, and reaching maturity activates focus branches for visible pregnancy, a large rain-bearing body, and delivery before term. The apparent cloud can therefore be carried as a gestational container whose hurried delivery yields punishment rather than water.

activation_trace.role: An inwardly borne load and developing fruit supply the gestational container schema.
Releasing a carried load through birth supplies the directional arrow from containment to delivery.
Arrival at a proper endpoint supplies the mature-term contrast required by premature delivery.
A pregnancy becoming outwardly visible supplies the focus object's swollen, readable appearance.
The split mapped root contributes a massive rain-bearing body and makes the gestational analogy materially weather-linked.
Delivery before full term supplies the focus-specific transformation of hastening into premature release.
Expected rainfall supplies the benign substance the apparently loaded body should have delivered.

structural_cues: The focus combines an apparently loaded sky-form, a contained payload, and explicit hastening; 46:15 has already foregrounded carrying, painful release, and term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the gestational sequence and the focus branch images; I supply the cloud-as-body analogy and the arrow from haste to premature delivery. The live alternative is ordinary meteorological containment with no birth model.

changed_reading.before: A cloud expected to release rain instead releases a destructive wind.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the visible cloud is a gestational body: their haste calls for delivery before term, and the delivered content is pain rather than provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior threat becomes binding, and the group explicitly demands that the promised event be brought. The focus correction then identifies the visible arrival with that earlier demand, turning the scene into a deictic callback from speech to presence.

activation_trace.role: A consequence becoming due and binding supplies the transition from warning to realized obligation.
The demand that something be made to come supplies the motion from verbal challenge toward visible arrival.
A threatened future evil supplies the specific promised object requested by the speakers.
The focus accusation of demanding premature arrival identifies the horizon event with the earlier challenge.
The event's face-to-face approach converts an abstract threat into present encounter.

structural_cues: The earlier second-person demand to bring the promised event is answered by the focus identification of the visible object as what the same addressees hurried.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the demand, threat, and later identification; I infer a speech-to-presence feedback loop, not physical causation by their words. The alternative is a straightforward narrative callback with no performative force.

changed_reading.before: The correction merely informs them what kind of weather has arrived.
changed_reading.after: The correction answers their own prior challenge: the object before them is the threatened future they demanded be converted into present evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins with people seeing and misidentifying an object. The next ayah reverses the visual relation: destruction makes the seers no longer visible while settled places remain, and the following ayah says ocular and inward capacities did not suffice. The wind becomes an instrument that judges seeing by converting subjects into absence.

activation_trace.role: Active sight supplies the opening relation between observers and the horizon object.
Comprehensive annihilation supplies the process that removes the observers from the visible field.
Negated and restricted sight supplies the reversal from seeing an object to no longer being seen.
Places of settlement supply the residual visible objects left after their inhabitants disappear.
Ocular capacity supplies the instrument that was present yet failed to secure recognition.
Inward discernment supplies the missing conversion from visual access to insight.
Failure to suffice states that sensory possession did not protect or benefit its possessors.

structural_cues: Active seeing in 46:24 is immediately answered by a passive, negated visibility construction in 46:25 and a parallel inventory of failed faculties in 46:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sight-erasure sequence and failed faculties; I infer that the destruction functions as a reversal of the visual relation. The alternative is simple narrative consequence followed by an independent moral comment.

changed_reading.before: They see badly and are then destroyed.
changed_reading.after: Their bad seeing is formally judged: the seen carrier erases the seers, leaves only their sites as objects, and exposes the insufficiency of unaided perception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus group sees and immediately speaks under the sign of haste. A later group hears, establishes attentive silence, waits for completion, and only then returns as warners. The contrast relocates the failure from sensory access to response tempo and receptive discipline.

activation_trace.role: Immediate visual access supplies the first group's sensory starting point.
Promptly voiced speech supplies the action that closes the first group's interpretation too soon.
Haste supplies the temporal disposition linking premature demand and premature judgment.
Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance supplies the contrasting receptive mode.
Speech is used here to organize reception rather than to impose a content label.
Attentive silence supplies the pause that keeps perception open.
Waiting until completion supplies the boundary after which response becomes appropriate.
Warning others supplies the accurate action produced by disciplined reception.

structural_cues: Both episodes use a perception-to-speech sequence, but 46:29 inserts attentive silence and completion before outward warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opposed sequences; I infer that reception tempo explains the changed outcomes. The alternative is contrast between two groups without a specific critique of haste in interpretation.

changed_reading.before: The focus group fails because sight is deceptive.
changed_reading.after: The focus group fails because it converts perception into speech too quickly; later attentive silence shows a live alternative route from sensation to truthful warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus terrain appears to be a receiving network for beneficial weather, yet the later repeated punishment-and-pain formula ties protection to answering a call. The following denial of escape and protecting allies removes land and social backing as alternatives, changing the valleys from expected receivers or refuges into exposure routes.

activation_trace.role: A terrain channel supplies the physical network into which the carrier advances.
Punitive suffering supplies the danger from which protection is needed.
Pain-causing force completes the focus formula repeated in the later rescue offer.
Responsive speech supplies the action on which the later route of safety turns.
Protected adjacency supplies a juridical shelter from the same kind of painful punishment.
Failure to outrun or evade pursuit removes geographic escape as a competing safety mechanism.
Protective alliance supplies the social refuge explicitly denied to nonresponders.

structural_cues: The punishment-plus-pain construction from the focus recurs in 46:31 inside an offer of rescue, followed immediately by denial of escape on earth and denial of protectors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies channel terrain, rescue, evasion, and protection; I infer that the valleys can carry a false-refuge expectation. The alternative is that the later protection language is general and does not spatially reinterpret the valleys.

changed_reading.before: The valleys are neutral terrain beneath the weather event.
changed_reading.after: The valleys become false topography of safety: physical channels admit the danger, while responsive hearing is presented later as the only effective shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the focus, observers inspect an appearing object and confidently identify it through a proximal label. Later they themselves are presented to fire, confronted with a proximal reality question, and made to answer and undergo it. Subject and object exchange places, while inferred knowledge gives way to compelled experience.

activation_trace.role: An object appearing before observers supplies the first side of the subject-object relation.
Judgment-like speech supplies the confident but mistaken first answer.
Being exposed for inspection reverses the earlier observers into the displayed objects.
Reality opposed to falsehood supplies the criterion they can no longer relabel.
Voiced admission supplies the corrected counterpart to the focus declaration.
Direct trial and experience replace inference as the final mode of knowing.

structural_cues: Both ayat coordinate presentation, a proximal demonstrative, speech, and correction, but 46:34 reverses who is presented and forces assent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared roots and deictic question-answer pattern; I infer a deliberate subject-object reversal. The alternative is broad eschatological repetition without a direct echo of the weather scene.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a local correction of a wrong object label.
changed_reading.after: The focus begins a larger reversal: those who wrongly classify what is presented will themselves be presented, correctly answer the same kind of proximal question, and know by undergoing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close commands the messenger to restrain haste toward the same people who had hastened the threat. When they finally see the promised event, their prior duration contracts in retrospect. The focus arrival becomes the hinge between impatient anticipation and collapsed remembered time.

activation_trace.role: The addressees' demand for advance arrival supplies one pole of the temporal asymmetry.
Self-restraint against agitation supplies the messenger's opposite temporal posture.
The explicit prohibition on accelerating their outcome mirrors and contains the focus accusation.
A bounded duration supplies the larger temporal frame within which waiting is reassessed.
Eventual sight supplies the threshold at which anticipated future becomes experienced present.
The threatened event supplies the future object whose arrival reorganizes remembered time.
Duration spent remaining in place supplies the span retrospectively compressed after sight.

structural_cues: The closing negative command using the same haste root directly mirrors the focus accusation, and the subsequent sight clause collapses the apparent waiting span.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the direct lexical reprise, opposite addressees, and retrospective duration; I infer that 46:24 is the temporal hinge between them. The alternative is a closing generalization whose link to the focus is thematic rather than structural.

changed_reading.before: Their haste explains only why punishment is mentioned in the focus.
changed_reading.after: Their haste is one side of a surah-closing temporal discipline: they demand the future early, the messenger must not, and actual sight makes the whole delay seem negligible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface directly denotes wind while the farther branches move through rest and death by euphemistic release. It remains anchored in the named carrier, the hoped-for rain, and the explicit punishment; downstream prose should present it only as a dark lexical polarity, not as an alternate dictionary gloss for the surface form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The expected rain is corrected to wind carrying painful punishment.

activation_trace.role: Moving air keeps the activation attached to the literal carrier in the focus.
Rest and recovered ease supply the relief the rain expectation implicitly promises.
Death expressed as release supplies the extreme endpoint into which hoped-for relief can invert.
Rainfall supplies the ordinary relief-bearing expectation needed for the polarity.
Punishment supplies the explicit harmful outcome that prevents the relief branch from becoming a literal reading.

changed_reading.before: Wind merely replaces the expected relief of rain with harm.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root-field resonance, the actual carrier holds a dark relief polarity: ease hoped for through weather turns into terminal release through punishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is form-distant because it depends on the non-dominant mapped root supplied for the seeing root and on remote deprivation branches of punishment. It remains worth carrying because both sides are anchored in focus roots and intensify the explicit rain-versus-pain reversal; render it as a water-affect resonance, never as a claim that seeing lexically means drinking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Sight produces an expectation of rain, but the corrected arrival contains punishment.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping's heavy rain-cloud branch ties visual recognition to an image of abundant water.
Water-satisfaction supplies the affective completion expected from the apparent weather.
Actual rainfall supplies the concrete material that would satisfy the expectation.
Abstention from drinking under severe thirst supplies a deprivation pole inside the punishment root field.
Withholding and prevention turn expected satisfaction into denied access.

changed_reading.before: They expect water but receive pain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sight activates a full satiation image while punishment activates withholding and thirst, making the correction an affective reversal from anticipated filling to enforced deprivation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the destructive branch is distant from the surface valley sense, and the following ayah contributes a separate entry-and-destruction root field. It remains anchored in the focus destination and immediate outcome; downstream prose should qualify it as lexical-spatial foreshadowing, not derive the valley noun from destruction or claim that terrain itself causes the event.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The incoming carrier is aligned with the valleys that lead toward the group's inhabited space.

activation_trace.role: A runoff passage supplies the literal terrain and the route by which the carrier enters.
Perishing within the same root inventory supplies a latent ruin shadow behind the neutral terrain noun.
Entry into a place supplies the inferred motion from valley route into inhabited space.
Eradicating destruction supplies the outcome that realizes the route's latent ruin shadow.

changed_reading.before: The valleys are merely where the apparent cloud is headed.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the valley is simultaneously conduit and lexical ruin-shadow: the route that promises water becomes the entry path of annihilation.

strongest_changes: The horizon appearance now mirrors earlier turning away: a posture toward warning can be carried as the shape of the unavoidable thing that later faces them.
The prior demand to bring the threat changes the focus correction into a deictic answer, while the closing no-haste command makes the ayah a hinge in a larger temporal asymmetry.
The sight sequence becomes a visibility reversal in which the seen carrier erases the seers, and the later listening-silence sequence supplies an alternative response tempo.
The later presentation to fire reverses observer and object, forcing experiential acknowledgment where the focus speakers had imposed a mistaken label.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mappings and distant but anchored branches preserved several otherwise collapsible activations: premature delivery from a loaded sky-form, relief turning toward death, satiation turning toward withholding, and valley conduit carrying a ruin shadow. These remain distinct from the stronger perceptual, temporal, and response-sequence models.
remaining_uncertainties: The reflexive link between earlier turning away and the later appearing phenomenon may be rhetorical root echo rather than a full mechanism.
The gestational model depends on branch-distant analogies even though context and focus jointly supply carrying, term, visible load, containment, and haste.
The contrast between immediate speech and later attentive listening may compare communities generally rather than diagnose interpretive tempo specifically.
The demand-and-arrival loop should not be read as the speakers physically causing the wind; the secure link is narrative and deictic.
